title: Hf1-xZrxO2: what sets the oxygen-vacancy formation energy

decision_points.fork: What controls E_f: cation identity of the first shell resolved by the two O sublattices (O3/O4), versus Zr count alone or geometric descriptors
decision_points.wrong_choice: Regress E_f on n_Zr with the sublattices pooled; or use the released geometric descriptors (identical within a sublattice in the staged cells) instead of cation identity
decision_points.consequence: Prediction RMSE ~0.12 eV and biases of 0.04-0.08 eV; x=0.25 population mean n_Zr 2.79 (pooled) or 1.00 (geometry) vs 2.24

decision_points.fork: Whether E_f depends on composition at fixed first-shell environment (a ~-0.03 eV shift per 0.25 in x, below the 0.02-0.035 eV within-class scatter and confounded with the Zr slope because each cell's environment mix follows its composition)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Fit one composition-blind local model to the x=0.50 table and the purchased x=0.25/0.75 sites
decision_points.consequence: Mean prediction error -0.028 eV at x=0.25 and +0.031 eV at x=0.75 (tolerance 0.02); x=0.75 site fraction low by 0.19 in log10

decision_points.fork: Spend budget on matched first-shell environments at x=0.25 and 0.75 (discriminating purchases) rather than transferring the free x=0.50 model
decision_points.wrong_choice: Assume purely local physics and transfer the x=0.50 table model to the other compositions
decision_points.consequence: Mean prediction errors -0.026 / +0.030 eV; x=0.75 site fraction low by 0.30 in log10

decision_points.fork: Environment statistics of the macroscopic random alloy versus those of the released 96-atom cells (one decoration at fixed composition)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Boltzmann-average over the 64 sites of the composition's supercell; or sample random 96-atom cells with exactly x*32 Zr (hypergeometric)
decision_points.consequence: x=0.25 cell has one 4-Zr O4 site of 64 (8x the random-alloy share): mean n_Zr 3.07 vs 2.24, 4-Zr share 0.43 vs 0.10; fixed-composition cells halve the 4-Zr probability (share 0.056)

decision_points.fork: Population = configurational degeneracy (environment probability) x Boltzmann factor
decision_points.wrong_choice: Boltzmann weights over environment classes without their multiplicity; or the lowest-energy class only

decision_points.fork: Rare low-energy environments that cannot be bought (the only 4-Zr site at x=0.25 is withheld) must be predicted by the model and included
decision_points.wrong_choice: Build the population from the classes actually purchased at that composition, dropping unseen ones

decision_points.fork: CASTEP cells: use the authors' per-calculation labels returned with each purchase; the released coordinates map onto the VASP x=0.50 cell but the decorations differ
decision_points.wrong_choice: Classify the purchased CASTEP-LDA sites with the environments of the VASP x=0.50 cell at the same index
decision_points.consequence: LDA Zr slope +0.045 instead of -0.111 eV (tolerance 0.05); with 10 random LDA sites this path passes 5 % of the time, against 98 % for the correct labels
decision_points.kind: inconsistency visible only in released metadata

decision_points.fork: Which conclusions transfer across functionals: the Zr softening does, the O3-O4 offset does not
decision_points.wrong_choice: Report the PBE description (VASP table or CASTEP-PBE) for LDA, treating the description as functional-independent

graded_fields: predicted_formation_energies_eV: 10 withheld sites per composition (x=0.25, 0.75); per composition RMSE <= 0.035 eV and |mean error| <= 0.02 eV
vacancy_Zr_neighbour_distribution: sum 1 +- 0.02; mean n_Zr within 0.25 (x=0.25) / 0.15 (x=0.75); 4-Zr share within 0.03 (x=0.25) / 0.08 (x=0.75)
lda_common_slope_model: offset within 0.075 eV, slope within 0.05 eV of the all-64-site least-squares values

length_estimate.catalog_note: 172 VASP vacancy sites + 3 pristine cells + 448 CASTEP vacancies + 45 CASTEP 3x3x3 vacancies at 2 units

files_used: Data.zip (members: Main text/Structures/Fig2b_e_0.25_HZO.cif, Fig2c_f_0.50_HZO.cif, FIG2d_g_0.75_HZO.cif; Main text/Fig_2/Data_Fig2b_g.csv; SM material/FIGS3.csv, FIGS4.txt, FIGS4 3x3x3_supercell.cif, FIGS5.txt, FIGS12.csv)

notes: Neutral vacancies only: the archive's +2 data use a VBM column that CompMat-Bench documents as the pristine-cell Fermi energy (0.92 eV above the true VBM), and charged-defect thermodynamics overlap CompMat-Bench task 202603_028. The design's composition-dependent oxygen-poor limit was replaced by the authors' single mu_O = -10.09 eV, stated in the prompt, because the archive contains no O2, metal or oxide reference energies. The design's Spearman and lowest-class targets were dropped (trivial: 4-Zr is lowest at every composition), and so was the O3 fraction at x=0.50 (exponentially sensitive and not discriminating between the degeneracy paths). They are replaced by the n_Zr distribution, site fractions and an LDA description. Contamination: no graded value uses the Fig2a_Fig3 reference cell or any CompMat-Bench target (see SOURCE.md).
